description: This Java class 'QuestionMapper' is a utility class providing static methods to convert 'Question' and 'Answer' entities into their corresponding API response DTOs ('QuestionResponse' and 'AnswerResponse'). It facilitates mapping between internal domain models and external API models, often used in serialization for REST APIs.

classes.name: QuestionMapper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to map domain entities ('Question' and 'Answer') to API response DTOs ('QuestionResponse' and 'AnswerResponse'). It handles conversion and optionally includes answers in the question response.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a 'Question' entity into a 'QuestionResponse' DTO. Optionally includes answers based on the 'includeAnswers' parameter.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an 'Answer' entity into an 'AnswerResponse' DTO.
